listening.title: Warehouse wait
listening.text: The driver has arrived at the warehouse, but the loading dock is still occupied. Please ask the driver to wait in the parking area and keep the phone available. The shipping team will call when the dock is ready. Let the broker know about the delay before the appointment time passes.

listening.title: Delivery paperwork
listening.text: Before the truck leaves the yard, check that the delivery address matches the paperwork. The receiver requires the driver to check in at the front office and wear a safety vest. After unloading, collect the signed delivery receipt and send a clear copy to the dispatch team.

listening.title: Morning handover
listening.text: The morning team should review the overnight messages before making new calls. One driver is waiting for a pickup number, and another has completed delivery. Please update the shared report with the latest confirmed information. Leave a clear note for any issue that still needs a response.

listening.title: Changed meeting
listening.text: Our team meeting has moved to the larger room near reception. The meeting will begin at the usual time, so please arrive a few minutes early. Bring your notes about the current projects. If you cannot attend, send your update to the team leader before the meeting starts.

listening.title: Traffic update
listening.text: The driver called to report slow traffic outside the city. The current arrival estimate may change, so do not promise an exact delivery time yet. Contact the broker with the information we have confirmed. Send another update after the driver reaches a safe place and checks the route.

listening.title: Document check
listening.text: A customer has requested a copy of the latest report. Before sending it, check the company name and reporting period at the top of the page. Make sure the attachment is the final version. Ask the customer to confirm that the file arrived and can be opened clearly.

listening.title: Visitor arrival
listening.text: A visitor is expected at the office this afternoon. Please ask them to sign in at reception and wait while their host is contacted. The meeting room is at the end of the hallway. If the visitor arrives early, offer them a seat and explain the expected waiting time.

listening.title: Missing reference
listening.text: The shipping office cannot find the shipment using the number on the load sheet. Please contact the broker to verify the pickup reference. Do not send the driver to a different warehouse without confirmation. Once the correct information arrives, update the record and read the details back to the driver.

listening.title: Shift coverage
listening.text: One member of the evening team will be absent today. The supervisor will divide the urgent work among the available staff. Check your assigned tasks before the shift begins. If a deadline conflicts with another commitment, explain the problem early so the team can agree on a workable plan.

listening.title: Clear photograph
listening.text: The photo of the delivery receipt is too dark to read. Please ask the driver to place the page on a flat surface in good light. The entire page should be visible in the new picture. Check the image before sending it to the client, and keep the original document available.

listening.title: Unconfirmed repair
listening.text: The truck is waiting for a repair inspection. We do not have a confirmed completion time, so the delivery estimate is still uncertain. Tell the broker what is known and what is being checked. Agree on a time for the next update, even if the repair is still in progress.

listening.title: Training session
listening.text: Tomorrow's training session will cover the new reporting form. Each team member should bring one example of a question they found difficult. The trainer will demonstrate the process before asking everyone to practice. Please take notes and ask for clarification if any step is unclear.

listening.title: Early arrival
listening.text: The driver expects to reach the receiver before the scheduled appointment. Call the facility to ask whether early check-in is possible. If it is not, request clear instructions about where the truck may wait. Confirm the plan with the driver and record the response in the load notes.

listening.title: Pending approval
listening.text: The draft has been prepared, but the manager has not approved the final figures. Keep the document in the shared folder and do not send it to the client yet. Highlight the entries that still need checking. Once approval arrives, update the version name and send the correct attachment.

listening.title: Contact details
listening.text: The phone number on the delivery instructions is no longer working. Please ask the broker for an updated contact at the receiving office. Confirm the person's name and department before ending the call. Add the new number to the load record so the next dispatcher can find it easily.

listening.title: End of shift
listening.text: Before finishing your shift, list the work that has been completed and the items still waiting for a reply. Include the last confirmed driver update for each active load. The next team needs to know who to contact and when. Keep the notes brief, specific, and easy to understand.

listening.title: Schedule conflict
listening.text: Two appointments have been entered at the same time. Please check the original messages to confirm which details are correct. Contact the organizers before moving either appointment. After a new arrangement is agreed, update the shared calendar and notify everyone affected by the change.

listening.title: Freight not ready
listening.text: The warehouse has advised that the freight is not ready for collection. The driver is waiting for further instructions in a permitted area. Ask the broker for the expected ready time and check the effect on delivery. Do not change the appointment until the new plan has been confirmed.

listening.title: Helpful follow-up
listening.text: After an important phone call, send a short written summary of the agreed actions. State who will complete each task and when an update is expected. Separate confirmed decisions from questions that remain open. Invite the other person to correct anything that does not match their understanding.

listening.title: Equipment details
listening.text: A new load offer has arrived, but some equipment details are missing. Ask the broker to confirm the trailer requirements and shipment information before accepting it. Check those details with the available driver. If anything is unsuitable or unclear, explain the issue and request clarification.

listening.title: Office maintenance
listening.text: The office printer will be unavailable during maintenance tomorrow morning. Please print any essential documents before the end of today. Digital copies can still be shared through the usual folder. Contact the office coordinator if an urgent document must be printed while the machine is being serviced.

listening.title: Receiver unavailable
listening.text: The receiver cannot unload the truck at the originally planned time. The broker has asked whether delivery tomorrow morning would be possible. Check the driver's availability and any effect on later commitments. Confirm the revised appointment and any agreed changes in writing before updating the schedule.

listening.title: Accurate update
listening.text: A client has asked for a status report, but the latest driver message is incomplete. Check the missing detail before describing the load as completed. You can tell the client which information is already confirmed. Explain what you are verifying and when they can expect another update.

listening.title: New colleague
listening.text: A new colleague will join the dispatch team next week. Please prepare a short guide to the shared folders and common contact numbers. Explain any abbreviations that may be unfamiliar. During the first shift, show the colleague how to leave clear notes and where to ask for help.

listening.title: Rate correction
listening.text: The amount on the rate confirmation does not match the figure discussed on the phone. Contact the broker and ask them to review the agreement. Keep a note of the difference and request corrected paperwork if needed. Both sides should confirm the same terms before the load proceeds.

listening.title: Safe response
listening.text: The driver is currently traveling and cannot answer a detailed question. Send a short message asking for a response when it is safe to stop. Use the last confirmed update in the meantime, and label any estimate clearly. Do not assume that an unanswered call means the delivery is late.

listening.title: Customer callback
listening.text: A customer called while the account manager was in a meeting. Please record the customer's name, contact number, and reason for calling. Ask whether the matter is urgent and confirm a suitable callback time. Send the message promptly so the manager can respond with the right information.

listening.title: Additional stop
listening.text: The broker has requested an extra stop on the delivery route. Ask for the full address, appointment details, and handling instructions. Check the effect on the driver's schedule before accepting the change. Record any agreed rate adjustment and send the confirmed plan to everyone who needs it.

listening.title: Report review
listening.text: The weekly report is ready for a final check. Compare the load references with the source records and look for missing dates. If a figure cannot be verified, mark it for follow-up instead of guessing. Send the report only after the required checks have been completed.

listening.title: Closing the day
listening.text: The final delivery update has arrived, but the paperwork is still pending. Note that difference clearly in the report before leaving. Ask the next dispatcher to follow up for a readable copy. The client should receive a confirmed status update without being told that all documents are complete.
